pergame_fp.label: Recent per-game scoring pace
pergame_fp.description: Points per game over his most recent games, weighted toward the latest ones — how well he's scoring right now, before accounting for how many games he's expected to play.

base_games.label: Games played last season
base_games.description: How many games he actually played last season — more games played is a stronger signal than a small sample.

expected_games.label: Expected games this season (health/role)
expected_games.description: Our own estimate of how many games he's projected to play this season, based on his role and recent availability.

snap_share.label: Snap share (playing time)
snap_share.description: The share of his team's offensive snaps he played — how big a role he holds on the field.

target_share.label: Target share (receiving role)
target_share.description: The share of his team's pass targets thrown his way — his role in the passing game.

carry_share.label: Carry share (rushing role)
carry_share.description: The share of his team's rushing attempts he gets — his role in the running game.

depth_rank.label: Depth-chart standing
depth_rank.description: Where he sits on his team's depth chart at his position — starter vs. backup.

mover_scale.label: Team-change opportunity
mover_scale.description: An adjustment for players who changed teams — a new opportunity, or a lost one, with a different roster around him.

team_env.label: Team offensive environment (Vegas win total)
team_env.description: How good his team's offense is expected to be this season, from Vegas win totals — a rising tide that lifts every skill player on that offense.

injury_cap_ratio.label: Injury / availability risk
injury_cap_ratio.description: How much his availability is capped by injury risk — 1.0 means no cap; lower means games are expected to be missed.

age.label: Player age
age.description: The player's age — older players carry more decline risk, younger players carry more unproven-role uncertainty.

fp_sd.label: Week-to-week scoring volatility
fp_sd.description: How much his fantasy scoring bounces around week to week — a volatile player vs. a consistent one.
